title: Jr. Fullstack Developer
subtitle: The Vision Group Food Ventures Inc. - Reservo
description: Supported the ongoing development of GoReservo by implementing selected full-stack features and improving existing workflows. My main contributions included waitlist management, marketing campaign tools, reservation down-payment rules, administrative resources, data import and export, responsive UI updates, SEO, and bug fixes.

Key Contributions
  • Built and expanded the restaurant waitlist and queue system, including guest registration, arrival windows, queue displays, voice announcements, notifications, guest preferences, history, and staff management screens.
  • Developed marketing campaign tools for email and SMS, including audience filters, recipient previews, scheduled delivery, message-credit checks, unsubscribe support, reusable email templates, and AI-assisted audience suggestions.
  • Added configurable reservation down-payment rules and carried the required fees through the booking and payment process.
  • Improved administrative tools for roles and permissions, subscription plans, message-credit tracking, restaurant staff, reservation sources, and activity logs.
  • Added import and export workflows for customers, reservations, tables, and products.
  • Created a staff schedule planner and added restaurant terms-and-conditions management.
  • Helped refresh the public website and improve SEO through page metadata, sitemap generation, robots configuration, accessibility labels, and llms.txt.
  • Handled smaller product improvements and bug fixes involving notifications, permissions, reservation statuses, table management, WhatsApp contact links, and administrative interfaces.
